directory.problem.cardCount: {place} {total} cards; search with the query of card_list
directory.problem.closeCards: Close matches: {shown}{more} ({place} {total} cards in all; search with the query of card_list)
directory.problem.elsewhereHint: . Write the ones in other sections with their section (for example: {example}:{raw}), or place a card ghost in section {section} to write them by name alone
directory.problem.ghostEmpty: "{raw}" is a card ghost, but it points to nothing (the card it pointed to is gone; re-point it with the target of card_update, or remove it with card_delete)
directory.problem.ghostRound: "{raw}" is a card ghost, but following what it points to goes round in a circle
directory.problem.manySections: Section "{name}" exists {count} times: {sections}. Write it from its parent
directory.problem.noSection: Section "{name}" does not exist. There are: {sections}
directory.problem.noSectionBeforeCard: "{raw}" has no section before the card. Do not write a tree in a path; put the section and ":" before the card (for example: {example}:{rest})
directory.problem.oldSectionPath: "{name}" is the old way of writing. Write sections from under the root: {rest}
directory.problem.sectionFromTop: Write a section from the top of the tree: {path} (the last name of the section alone is not enough)
directory.problem.treeInPath: "{tree}@" cannot be written in a path. A path does not name a tree (main@ is read with the @ removed). To work inside a branch, name it with the branch argument in MCP (main if omitted), or use the branch open in the window
directory.problem.writeWithSection: Write it with its section (for example: {example}:{raw}). {detail}
